preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of the binary string N must be between 2 and 1,000.
The number of jumps K must be between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: len(S) == N and all(c in '01' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The binary string S must have a length of N and consist only of '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(farthest_block) if farthest_block != -1 else stdout == '-1'
postconditions.description: The output must be the farthest block Chef can reach with exactly K jumps, or -1 if Chef cannot jump exactly K times.
